limitations: The formula applies to finite commutative local unital rings with \(J^2=0\) and J nonzero; it does not classify general finite rings or higher radical length.
The sharp field-value collision at k=2 is unique within the square-zero local family, but unrestricted \(k\ge3\) equality remains open.
No claim is made that every order-eight ring with field-value ideal probability has been classified.
Historical priority beyond inspected and searched sources has not received independent validation.
title: Square-zero local ideal-product probabilities and a minimal field-recognition counterexample
